paragraphs.text: Outside Mutter's Spiral is a catch-all non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who on the card The Cheetah Planet .

Mutter's Spiral is the Time Lord designation for the star cluster in which Earth 's solar system was located. The Cheetah Planet was a mysterious sentient planet and the homeworld of the Cheetah People and Kitlings . Located outside the Mutter's Spiral, the Cheetah Planet had a red-tinted sky, red sun, and peach-colored moon. It had rough terrain, featuring rocks and sand. Due to the Cheetah People and Kitlings' hostility to extraterrestrial visitors, the planet was littered with the bones of dead humans and other galactic creatures. The planet was in some sense conscious and empathic, connected to the Cheetah People. The Cheetah People were originally a humanoid civilization and gained their beastly characteristics from prolonged exposure to the "power" pervading their planet. The same mutation would begin to overtake humans and even Time Lords if they spent too long on the Cheetah Planet.
